leadText:
This is the 13th chapter of the Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master! manga. It was first published in the August 2023 issue of CoroCoro Ichiban!, released on June 21, 2023. It is 18 pages long.

It was made available on Weekly CoroCoro Comics on November 27, 2023.
